name: Vowelconsonantshiftcipher

description_json.name: VowelConsonantShiftCipher
description_json.idea: Shift vowels and consonants separately within their respective groups to disrupt standard tokenization while remaining highly structured and easy for the model to compute. Vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are shifted forward by 1 position in the vowel sequence. Consonants are shifted forward by 1 position in the alphabet (skipping vowels). Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: For any alphabetic character: 1. If it is a vowel (a, e, i, o, u, case-insensitive), shift it to the next vowel in the sequence 'aeioua' (e.g., 'a' -> 'e', 'u' -> 'a'). 2. If it is a consonant, shift it to the next consonant in the alphabetical sequence (skipping vowels: 'b'->'c', 'd'->'f', 'h'->'j', 'n'->'p', 't'->'v', 'z'->'b'). 3. Preserve the original case. 4. All other characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: For any alphabetic character: 1. If it is a vowel (a, e, i, o, u, case-insensitive), shift it to the previous vowel in the sequence 'aeioua' (e.g., 'e' -> 'a', 'a' -> 'u'). 2. If it is a consonant, shift it to the previous consonant in the alphabetical sequence (skipping vowels: 'c'->'b', 'f'->'d', 'j'->'h', 'p'->'n', 'v'->'t', 'b'->'z'). 3. Preserve the original case. 4. All other characters remain unchanged.
